LanguageData.ColonistSummary_Failed: The Summary tab hit a problem and stops drawing until the game restarts. The log has the details.
LanguageData.ColonistSummary_Settings_FitToColonistsT: Makes the Summary tab only as tall as its colonists need: it sits on the bottom bar, grows upwards as colonists join and shrinks as they leave. The height above is then the most it grows to; past that the list scrolls.\n\nSearching doesn't change its height, so nothing moves under the mouse while you type.
LanguageData.ColonistSummary_Settings_ResetTip: Puts the window size settings back to their defaults.
LanguageData.ColonistSummary_Settings_ResetNothing: The window size settings are already at their defaults.
LanguageData.ColonistSummary_RowTip: Click to select this colonist and jump to them.
LanguageData.ColonistSummary_WorkTemplateTip: Work templates from UI Rethemed - Work: {0}
LanguageData.ColonistSummary_SearchTip: Finds colonists by name, weapon or apparel.
LanguageData.ColonistSummary_SortButtonTip: Sorted by {0}, {1}. Click a column heading to sort by it, again to reverse, and a third time for the usual order, or open this menu for every choice.
LanguageData.ColonistSummary_Stat_ColonistsTip: Free colonists on every map, in caravans and in transporters, except babies.
LanguageData.ColonistSummary_Stat_UncomfortableTip: Colonists outside their comfortable temperature range where they are.
LanguageData.ColonistSummary_Column_IdeoTip: Click an icon to open the ideoligion.
LanguageData.ColonistSummary_Column_HostilityTip: What each colonist does when enemies come near. Click to change it.
LanguageData.ColonistSummary_Column_BleedingTip: Time until death by blood loss: red within half a day, yellow within a day. Green shows the bleed rate per day when there's no risk of bleeding out soon. Hover for the blood left and each bleeding wound.
LanguageData.ColonistSummary_Column_InfectionTip: Infections and other diseases the body builds immunity to, such as flu, plague and malaria. Green while immunity is winning, yellow when it's winning only just, red while the disease is. With more than one, the cell shows the worst.
LanguageData.ColonistSummary_InfectionClose: Immunity is winning, but only just: immune in {0}.
LanguageData.ColonistSummary_InfectionSafe: Immunity is winning: the disease isn't getting worse.
LanguageData.ColonistSummary_InfectionLosing: The disease is winning: fatal in {0}, before immunity.
LanguageData.ColonistSummary_InfectionKeepTended: Keep it tended: untended, the disease would win.
LanguageData.ColonistSummary_Column_WeaponTip: Equipped weapons. Click one to open its info card.
LanguageData.ColonistSummary_Column_ApparelTip: Worn apparel, head to toe with outer layers first. Each slot lines up down the column, with an empty box where a colonist wears nothing in it. Click one to open its info card. Sorts by the number of items worn.
LanguageData.ColonistSummary_Column_SharpTip: Overall sharp armor, from apparel and body. The bar fills at 100%.
LanguageData.ColonistSummary_Column_BluntTip: Overall blunt armor, from apparel and body. The bar fills at 100%.
LanguageData.ColonistSummary_Column_HeatTip: Overall heat armor, from apparel and body. The bar fills at 100%.
LanguageData.ColonistSummary_Column_ComfortTip: Comfortable temperature range, in green while the current temperature is inside it. Sorts by the lowest comfortable temperature.
